title: Q&A with Reiner Pope, a former Google TPU architect and CEO of MatX, which designs specialized chips for LLMs, on the limitations of current AI chips, and more (John Collison/Cheeky Pint)
summary: John Collison / Cheeky Pint: Q&A with Reiner Pope, a former Google TPU architect and CEO of MatX, which designs specialized chips for LLMs, on the limitations of current AI chips, and more — Reiner Pope is the co-founder and CEO of MatX, designing specialized chips for Large Language Models.
